algorithms.name: find-supported-configuration
algorithms.html: In order to <dfn class="dfn-paneled has-dfn-panel" data-dfn-type="dfn" data-noexport="" id="find-supported-configuration-combination" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0">find supported configuration combination</dfn> for depth sensing API given <var>depthStateInit</var> dictionary, the user agent MUST run the following algorithm:

steps.html: Let depthTypeRequest be the value contained by the depthTypeRequest key in depthStateInit if it is set, and an empty sequence otherwise.
Let selectedType be null
Let usagePreference be the value contained by the usagePreference key in depthStateInit
Let selectedUsage be null.
Let dataFormatPreference be the value contained by the dataFormatPreference key in depthStateInit
Let selectedDataFormat be null.

Let processingOrder be the sequence of (preferences, selection) pairs, where selection is a reference to one of the variables introduced in the previous steps: [(depthTypeRequest, selectedType), (usagePreference,selectedUsage),(dataFormatPreference,selectedDataFormat)]
For each (<var>preferences</var>, <var>selection</var>) in <var>processingOrder</var> perform the following steps
If preferences contains only a single value, set selection to that value.
For each (<var>preferences</var>, <var>selection</var>) in <var>processingOrder</var> perform the following steps:
If selection is not null, continue to the next entry.
If the preferences sequence is empty, continue to the next entry.
For each preference in preferences, preform the following steps:

If preference with the other values of selectedType,selectedUsage,selectedDataFormat is not considered a supported depth sensing configuration by the native depth sensing capabilities of the device, continue to the next entry.
Set selection to preference and abort these nested steps.
For each (<var>preferences</var>, <var>selection</var>) in <var>processingOrder</var> perform the following steps:
If selection is not null, continue to the next entry.
Set selection to the value determined by the preferred native depth sensing capability with the other values of selectedType,selectedUsage,selectedDataFormat.
If any of selectedType,selectedUsage,selectedDataFormat are null, return null and abort these steps.

If selectedType,selectedUsage,selectedDataFormat is considered a supported depth sensing configuration by the native depth sensing capabilities of the device return the depth sensing configuration of selectedType,selectedUsage,selectedDataFormat and abort these steps.
If depthTypeRequest is not an empty list, set it to an empty list and repeat these steps.
Return null and abort these steps.

algorithms.name: start-depth-sensing
algorithms.html: When resumeDepthSensing() is invoked on an XRSession session, the User Agent MUST run the following steps:

steps.html: If session’s ended value is true, throw an InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
Let frame be session’s animation frame.
If frame’s active boolean is false, throw an InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
If depth-sensing feature descriptor is not contained in the session’s XR device’s list of enabled features for session’s mode, throw a NotSupportedError and abort these steps.
If depth sensing active state is true, abort these steps.
Set depth sensing active state to true.

algorithms.name: stop-depth-sensing
algorithms.html: When pauseDepthSensing() is invoked on an XRSession session, the User Agent MUST run the following steps:

steps.html: If session’s ended value is true, throw an InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
Let frame be session’s animation frame.
If frame’s active boolean is false, throw an InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
If depth-sensing feature descriptor is not contained in the session’s XR device’s list of enabled features for session’s mode, throw a NotSupportedError and abort these steps.
If depth sensing active state is false, abort these steps.
Set depth sensing active state to false.

algorithms.name: accessing-depth-buffer-members
algorithms.html: When attempting to access the depth buffer of XRDepthInformation or any interface that inherits from it, the user agent MUST run the following steps:

steps.html: Let depthInformation be the instance whose member is accessed.
Let view be the depthInformation’s view.
Let frame be the view’s frame.
If frame is not active, throw InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
If frame is not an animationFrame, throw InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
Proceed with normal steps required to access the member of depthInformation.

algorithms.name: obtain-depth-at-coordinates
algorithms.html: When getDepthInMeters(x, y) method is invoked on an XRCPUDepthInformation depthInformation with x, y, the user agent MUST obtain depth at coordinates by running the following steps:

steps.html: Let view be the depthInformation’s view, frame be view’s frame, and session be the frame’s session.
If x is greater than 1.0 or less than 0.0, throw RangeError and abort these steps.
If y is greater than 1.0 or less than 0.0, throw RangeError and abort these steps.
Let normalizedViewCoordinates be a vector representing 3-dimensional point in space, with x coordinate set to x, y coordinate set to y, z coordinate set to 0.0, and w coordinate set to 1.0.
Let normalizedDepthCoordinates be a result of premultiplying normalizedViewCoordinates vector from the left by depthInformation’s normDepthBufferFromNormView.
Let depthCoordinates be a result of scaling normalizedDepthCoordinates, with x coordinate multiplied by depthInformation’s width and y coordinate multiplied by depthInformation’s height.
Let column be the value of depthCoordinates’ x coordinate, truncated to an integer, and clamped to [0, width-1] integer range.
Let row be the value of depthCoordinates’ y coordinate, truncated to an integer, and clamped to [0, height-1] integer range.
Let index be equal to row multiplied by width & added to column.
Let byteIndex be equal to index multiplied by the size of the depth data format.
Let rawDepth be equal to a value found at index byteIndex in data, interpreted as a number accordingly to session’s depthDataFormat.
Let rawValueToMeters be equal to depthInformation’s rawValueToMeters.
Return rawDepth multiplied by rawValueToMeters.

algorithms.name: obtain-depth-information
algorithms.html: When getDepthInformation(view) method is invoked on an XRFrame frame with an XRView view, the user agent MUST obtain CPU depth information by running the following steps:

steps.html: Let session be frame’s session.
If depth-sensing feature descriptor is not contained in the session’s XR device’s list of enabled features for session’s mode, throw a NotSupportedError and abort these steps.
If frame’s active boolean is false, throw an InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
If frame’s animationFrame boolean is false, throw an InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
If frame does not match view’s frame, throw an InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
If the session’s depthUsage is not "cpu-optimized", throw an InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
Let depthInformation be a result of creating a CPU depth information instance given frame and view.
Return depthInformation.

algorithms.name: create-cpu-depth-information
algorithms.html: In order to create a CPU depth information instance given XRFrame frame and XRView view, the user agent MUST run the following steps:

steps.html: Let result be a new instance of XRCPUDepthInformation.
Let time be frame’s time.
Let session be frame’s session.
Let device be the session’s XR device.
If depthActive is false, return null and abort these steps.

Let nativeDepthInformation be the native depth information obtained by querying device for the depth information valid as of time, for specified view, taking into account session’s depthType, depthUsage, and depthDataFormat.
If nativeDepthInformation is null, return null and abort these steps.
Let nativeDepthBuffer be nativeDepthInformation’s native depth buffer.
If nativeDepthBuffer meets user agent’s criteria to block access to the depth data, return null and abort these steps.
If nativeDepthBuffer meets user agent’s criteria to limit the amount of information available in depth buffer, adjust nativeDepthBuffer accordingly.
Initialize result’s width to nativeDepthBuffer’s width.
Initialize result’s height to nativeDepthBuffer’s height.
Initialize result’s normDepthBufferFromNormView to a new XRRigidTransform, based on nativeDepthInformation’s depth coordinates transformation matrix.
Initialize result’s rawValueToMeters to the scale factor supplied by nativeDepthInformation.
Initialize result’s data to a copy of the raw depth values for view from nativeDepthBuffer.
Initialize result’s view to view.
Initialize result’s transform to the sensor’s pose at time in view’s reference space.
Return result.

algorithms.name: obtain-webgl-depth-information
algorithms.html: When getDepthInformation(view) method is invoked on a XRWebGLBinding binding with an XRView view, the user agent MUST obtain WebGL depth information by running the following steps:

steps.html: Let session be binding’s session.
Let frame be view’s frame.
If session does not match frame’s session, throw an InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
If depth-sensing feature descriptor is not contained in the session’s XR device’s list of enabled features for session’s mode, throw a NotSupportedError and abort these steps.
If the session’s depthUsage is not "gpu-optimized", throw an InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
If frame’s active boolean is false, throw an InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
If frame’s animationFrame boolean is false, throw an InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
Let depthInformation be a result of creating a WebGL depth information instance given frame and view.
Return depthInformation.

algorithms.name: create-webgl-depth-information
algorithms.html: In order to create a WebGL depth information instance given XRFrame frame and XRView view, the user agent MUST run the following steps:

steps.html: Let result be a new instance of XRWebGLDepthInformation.
Initialize <var>time</var> as follows:

steps.case: If the XRSession was created with matchDepthView set to true:
steps.html: Let time be frame’s time.
Let <var>time</var> be time that the <var>device</var> captured the depth information.
Let session be frame’s session.
Let device be the session’s XR device.
If depthActive is false, return null and abort these steps.

Let nativeDepthInformation be the native depth information obtained by querying device’s native depth sensing for the depth information valid as of time, for specified view, taking into account session’s depthType, depthUsage, and depthDataFormat.
If nativeDepthInformation is null, return null and abort these steps.
Let nativeDepthBuffer be nativeDepthInformation’s native depth buffer.
If nativeDepthBuffer meets user agent’s criteria to block access to the depth data, return null and abort these steps.
If nativeDepthBuffer meets user agent’s criteria to limit the amount of information available in depth buffer, adjust nativeDepthBuffer accordingly.
Initialize result’s width to nativeDepthBuffer’s width.
Initialize result’s height to nativeDepthBuffer’s height.
Initialize result’s normDepthBufferFromNormView to a new XRRigidTransform, based on nativeDepthInformation’s depth coordinates transformation matrix.
Initialize result’s rawValueToMeters to the scale factor supplied by nativeDepthInformation.
Initialize result’s texture to an opaque texture containing nativeDepthBuffer.
Initialize result’s view to view.
Initialize result’s transform to the sensor’s pose at time in view’s reference space.
Initialize result’s textureType as follows:

steps.case: If the result’s texture was created with a textureType of texture-array:
steps.html: Initialize result’s textureType to "texture-array".
Initialize result’s textureType to "texture".
Initialize result’s imageIndex as follows:
Initialize result’s imageIndex to null.
Initialize result’s imageIndex to 1.
Initialize result’s imageIndex to 0.
Return result.

algorithms.name: get WebGPU depth view descriptor
algorithms.html: The getViewDescriptor() method returns a GPUTextureViewDescriptor configured to create a two-dimensional view of the portion of texture containing this object’s depth information.

steps.html: Run the algorithm to attempt to access the depth buffer with depthInformation.
Let descriptor be a new GPUTextureViewDescriptor.
Set descriptor’s dimension to "2d".
Set descriptor’s baseMipLevel to `0`.
Set descriptor’s mipLevelCount to `1`.
Set descriptor’s baseArrayLayer to depthInformation’s array layer index.
Set descriptor’s arrayLayerCount to `1`.
Return descriptor.

algorithms.html: The XR animation frame algorithm is extended as follows: immediately before setting the XRFrame’s active boolean to false, the user agent MUST run the following steps:

steps.html: For each texture in the XRFrame’s list of WebGPU depth textures:

Before the native depth buffer backing texture is modified or reused, ensure that all WebGPU work submitted during the processing of this XRFrame that accesses texture has completed, or synchronize that work with the native depth sensing implementation using an equivalent GPU-side dependency.
Call destroy() on texture without destroying its underlying native depth buffer.
Set the XRFrame’s list of WebGPU depth textures to an empty list.

algorithms.name: obtain-webgpu-depth-information
algorithms.html: When getDepthInformation(view) is invoked on an XRGPUBinding binding with an XRView view, the user agent MUST obtain WebGPU depth information by running the following steps:

steps.html: Let session be binding’s session.
Let device be binding’s device.
Let frame be view’s frame.
If session does not match frame’s session, throw an InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
If depth-sensing feature descriptor is not contained in the session’s XR device’s list of enabled features for session’s mode, throw a NotSupportedError and abort these steps.
If session’s depthUsage is not "gpu-optimized", throw an InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
If device has been destroyed, throw an InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
If frame’s active boolean is false, throw an InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
If frame’s animationFrame boolean is false, throw an InvalidStateError and abort these steps.
Let depthInformation be the result of creating a WebGPU depth information instance given binding, frame, and view.
Return depthInformation.

algorithms.name: create-webgpu-depth-information
algorithms.html: In order to create a WebGPU depth information instance given an XRGPUBinding binding, an XRFrame frame, and an XRView view, the user agent MUST run the following steps:

steps.html: Let result be a new instance of XRGPUDepthInformation.
Let session be frame’s session.
Let xrDevice be session’s XR device.
Let gpuDevice be binding’s device.
Initialize <var>time</var> as follows:

steps.case: If session was created with matchDepthView set to true:
steps.html: Let time be frame’s time.
Let <var>time</var> be the time that <var>xrDevice</var> captured the depth information.
If depthActive is false, return null and abort these steps.

Let nativeDepthInformation be the native depth information obtained by querying xrDevice’s native depth sensing for the depth information valid as of time, for the specified view, taking into account session’s depthType, depthUsage, and depthDataFormat.
If nativeDepthInformation is null, return null and abort these steps.
Let nativeDepthBuffer be nativeDepthInformation’s native depth buffer.
If nativeDepthBuffer meets the user agent’s criteria to block access to the depth data, return null and abort these steps.
If nativeDepthBuffer meets the user agent’s criteria to limit the amount of information available in the depth buffer, adjust nativeDepthBuffer accordingly.
Initialize result’s width to nativeDepthBuffer’s width.
Initialize result’s height to nativeDepthBuffer’s height.
Initialize result’s normDepthBufferFromNormView to a new XRRigidTransform, based on nativeDepthInformation’s depth coordinates transformation matrix.
Initialize result’s rawValueToMeters to the scale factor supplied by nativeDepthInformation.
Let format be the GPUTextureFormat corresponding to session’s depthDataFormat in the § 2.2 Intended depth type, data usage, and data formats table.
Let arrayLayerCount be the number of array layers in nativeDepthBuffer, or `1` if nativeDepthBuffer is not layered.
Let arrayLayerIndex be `0` if arrayLayerCount is `1`; otherwise, let it be view’s index.
Assert that arrayLayerIndex is less than arrayLayerCount.

Let descriptor be a new GPUTextureDescriptor with the following members:

  • size set to a GPUExtent3D whose width is result’s width, height is result’s height, and depth or array layer count is arrayLayerCount.

  • mipLevelCount set to `1`.

  • sampleCount set to `1`.

  • dimension set to "2d".

  • format set to format.

  • usage set to TEXTURE_BINDING.

  • viewFormats set to an empty sequence.
Initialize result’s texture to the result of calling gpuDevice.createTexture() with descriptor, except with the GPUTexture’s underlying storage pointing to nativeDepthBuffer.
Initialize result’s array layer index to arrayLayerIndex.
Append result’s texture to frame’s list of WebGPU depth textures.
Initialize result’s view to view.
Initialize result’s transform to the sensor’s pose at time in view’s reference space.
Return result.
